info.title: Yemeksepeti Partner API
info.description:
Welcome to the Partner API, your gateway to seamless integration with our platform.
This API empowers your applications to connect directly with our system, allowing you to:

* **Manage your Product Catalog:**  Easily add and update products ensuring your offerings are always up to date.
* **Process Orders efficiently:** Receive real-time order updates, confirm orders, and manage order statuses for a smooth fulfillment process.
* **Grow your business:** Create and manage promotions to attract customers and boost sales.
* **Gain valuable Insights:** Access order history and other data to optimize your operations and enhance customer satisfaction.

This API is designed for partners, looking to reach more customers and streamline their operations through our platform.

**Getting Started**

1. **Get your API keys:** Contact your account manager or visit our Partner Portal to request your API keys.
2. **Explore the API Documentation:** Familiarize yourself with the available endpoints and data structures in this document.
3. **Start Integrating:** Use your preferred programming language and tools to integrate the Partner API into your applications.

**Glossary**

* **Vendor:** The store, outlet or merchant listed on our platform responsible for fulfilling orders and managing their product catalog.
* **Chain:** A group of stores operating under a common brand, franchise, or region. Our API allows you to manage all outlets in the chain with a single API key.
* **Job:** A background process that handles time-consuming tasks, such as product assignment or catalog export.
* **Webhook:** A mechanism for receiving real-time notifications about events on our platform, such as order updates or job completions.
* **SKU (Stock Keeping Unit):** A unique code used to identify a specific product in your inventory.
* **GTIN (Global Trade Item Number):** A globally unique identifier for a product, such as a barcode (e.g., EAN, UPC).
* **POS (Point of Sale):** The system used to process transactions and manage orders at your physical store location.

## Sandbox Environment

The **Sandbox Environment** is a safe workspace that exactly mirrors the Partner API Live Environment. It allows you to fully test your integration before going live — without affecting real products, orders, or production data.

Direct your test requests to:

```text
https://sandbox.partner.deliveryhero.io
```

**What you need to know:**

* **Seamless transition:** Paths, payloads, and error responses are identical to production. Only the host URL changes.
* **Separate credentials:** Your production credentials will not work in the Sandbox, and vice versa.
* **Supported endpoints:** The Sandbox currently supports the [Authentication](#tag/Authentication), [Catalog Updates](#tag/Catalog), [Category](#tag/Category) and [Order](#tag/Order) endpoints. Every endpoint it serves lists **Sandbox environment** in the server dropdown next to its request samples.

To set up your Sandbox, create your credentials via Partner Portal self-service — see the [Sandbox developer documentation](https://developer.yemeksepeti.com/en/documentation/sandbox-sandbox-testing) — or contact your account manager.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description:
Our platform uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Flow for authentication. You can generate `access_token` by calling [Generate Access Token](#tag/Authentication/operation/generateAccessToken) endpoint using your client credentials.

**How to authenticate**:
1. Generate your `client_id` and `client_secret` in the Partner Portal, under the **Shop Integrations Plugin** section in **All Settings**.
2. Make a request to [Generate Access Token](#tag/Authentication/operation/generateAccessToken) endpoint to retrieve your `access_token` 
3. Include your `access_token` in the `Authorization` header of every request you make to the Partner API. Prefix your `access_token` with the string `Bearer` followed by a space. For example: 
  ```
  Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
  ```
4. If authentication is missing or invalid, any API call will respond with a `401 Unauthorized` error. 

⚠️ The access token is a short-lived JSON Web Token (JWT). **It is highly recommended to cache and reuse this token for all API calls until it expires!** Use the value of the `expires_in` field from the `/oauth/token` response as the Time-To-Live (TTL) for the cached token.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description:
Manage and optimize your product catalog with precision and efficiency. This section provides a comprehensive set of endpoints to streamline your product management workflows. 

 **Key Features:**

 * **Effortless Product Management:** Add new products, update existing ones, and deactivate outdated listings.  
 * **Bulk Operations:**  Perform bulk updates to efficiently manage large product catalogs.
 * **Asynchronous Processing:**   Initiate time-consuming tasks, such as product assignments and exports, in the background to free up your resources.
 * **Detailed Product Information:**  Access and manage a wide range of product attributes, including titles, descriptions, images, pricing, inventory, and categories.
 * **Flexible Filtering and Search:**  Retrieve specific products or subsets of your catalog using powerful filtering and search capabilities.
 * **Export Functionality:** Download complete or filtered product data for analysis, reporting, or archival purposes.

tags.name: Category
tags.description:
Organize your products effectively with a robust category structure. This section offers endpoint to retrieve the hierarchical relationships between your product categories, enabling efficient navigation and filtering for you.

**Key Features:**

* **Hierarchical Structure:**  Established parent-child relationships between categories to create a logical and intuitive structure.
* **Leaf Category Filtering:**  Retrieve only the most specific categories (those without subcategories) for streamlined data retrieval.

tags.name: Order
tags.description:
Streamline your order processing and fulfillment workflows for a seamless customer experience. This section provides endpoints to access, manage, and update order information in real-time, ensuring efficient and accurate order fulfillment.

**Key Features:**

* **Real-time Order Updates:**  Receive and process order updates as they happen, enabling immediate action and reducing delays.
* **Order Status Management:** Update order statuses to reflect the progress of each order, keeping customers informed and improving transparency.
* **Item Modification and Cancellation:**  Make changes to order items, handle replacements, and manage cancellations efficiently.
* **POS Integration:**  Seamlessly integrate your point-of-sale systems with our platform for automated order updates and streamlined operations.
* **Order History and Reconciliation:**  Retrieve detailed order history for reconciliation, analysis, and reporting purposes.

tags.name: Promotion
tags.description:
**Drive sales and boost customer engagement with targeted promotions.** This section provides endpoints for creating and managing a variety of promotional campaigns to incentivize purchases and enhance customer loyalty.

**Key Features:**

* **Flexible Promotion Types:**  Implement various promotion types, including discounts, bundles, and special offers.
* **Promotion Scheduling:**  Schedule promotions to run for specific durations.
* **Easy Updates and Deactivation:**  Modify existing promotions, add or remove products, or deactivate campaigns as needed.
* **Asynchronous Processing:**  Create or update promotions in the background for efficient processing and resource management.
* **Status Tracking:**  Monitor the status and outcome of your promotion updates to ensure they are applied correctly.

tags.name: Outlet Management
tags.description:
**Control your outlet's operational status and schedule with ease, ensuring accurate availability information for customers.** This section offers endpoints to manage opening hours, closures, and check-ins, providing real-time updates and flexible control over your outlet's operations.

**Key Features:**

* **Real-time Status Updates:** Instantly update and retrieve your outlet's status (open/closed) and schedule changes, reflecting current availability.
* **Flexible Control:** Manage opening hours, temporary closures (busy mode), and required check-ins before opening the outlet for customers, adapting to operational needs.

Generate an OAuth 2.0 access token to include in the Authorization header of Partner API requests.

**Rate Limiting:** This endpoint is rate-limited to 50 requests per minute per client ID. If you exceed this limit, you will receive a `429 Too Many Requests` response.

Example:

```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJQUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9eyJ1dWlkIjoiVEVTVCJ9
```

**Track the progress of your product listings**. This endpoint allows you to monitor the status of your product addition jobs. Check if your job is `QUEUED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED` or `FAILED`
- `QUEUED` the job has not yet been processed
- `IN_PROGRESS` the products/items are being added to your outlet.
- `COMPLETED` the job is finished
- `FAILED` the job processing failed

Access a comprehensive, paginated list of products assigned to a vendor. 
This endpoint allows you to efficiently retrieve and filter your product data. 
Use query parameters to: Search for products by **name**, **SKU** or **barcode** (`query_term`). 
* Filter by specific categories (`category_global_ids`). 
* Refine results by locale (`locale`) and active status (`is_active`).
* Control the number of results per page (`page_size`) and navigate through pages (`page`).

put.description:
Update product information efficiently, whether it's a single item or a whole batch. We'll process your request in the background and provide a `202 Accepted` status with a `job_id` for tracking. 
Stay updated via **webhook notifications** defined under **Callbacks → Update products results webhook** at the bottom of this operation. 

☝️**Pro tip**: It's always more efficient to send a single request with 10,000 items than to make 10,000 individual updates. Given the asynchronous nature of the API, this approach not only reduces redundant computations but also improves overall processing time and simplifies feedback handling.

put.description:
Create or update promotions to boost your sales and engage customers. This endpoint simplifies promotion management with its upsert functionality:

  * **Create new promotions:** Define the promotion details, including the type, discounts, conditions, and target audience.
  * **Update existing promotions:** Modify any aspect of your promotion, add or remove products, or deactivate it entirely.

  The API intelligently determines whether to create a new promotion or update an existing one based on the unique combination of `name`, `vendors`, `condition.start_time`, and `condition.end_time`. 

  ☝️**Pro tip**: It's always more efficient to send a single promotion request with 1,000 items than to make 1,000 individual updates. Given the asynchronous nature of the API, this approach not only reduces redundant computations but also improves overall processing time and simplifies feedback handling.

  🚧 **WORK IN PROGRESS** — The Same Item Bundle promotion type is currently under active development and will be available soon. The API contract has been updated and is not expected to change.

get.description:
This endpoint provides the status of the promotion update job:
- `QUEUED` if the job has not yet been processed.
- `COMPLETED` if the job has finished processing.
- `FAILED` if the job processing failed.
- `DUPLICATE` if the job was skipped due to duplicate promotion entries.

Please note: for update cases (promotion already exists for a specific time interval for a given set of vendors), once processed, the job status will always be `COMPLETED` even if all items from the request are not valid. In contrast, for a new promotion, in this case, the job status will be `FAILED`

`result` provides additional details about the job processing, such as any SKUs or vendors that will not be included in the promotion due to an error once the processing is complete.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Job ID from the response of the PUT `/promotion` endpoint

get.description:
Gets availability status of the given vendor. The following statuses:
* `CLOSED_TODAY` - the vendor was closed and will stay not operational for entire day 
* `CLOSED_UNTIL` - the vendor was closed till specific date-time. Specific closure time is specified in `closed_until` field
* `CLOSED` - the vendor was closed without end date
* `OPEN` - the vendor is operational

parameters.description: Unique vendor identifier generated by our platform
parameters.name: vendor_id

Closed (technical problems).description: Closed outlet due to technical problems

Closed (check-in required).description: Closed outlet due to check-in required

put.description:
Updates an availability status of the given vendor. Supported statuses are:  
* `CLOSED_TODAY` - vendor will be closed till the end of the day
* `CLOSED_UNTIL` - vendor will be closed till the date specified in `closed_until` field
* `OPEN` - open closed vendor if it's within opening hours according to schedule.
* `CHECKIN` - use this status to acknowledge required check in. This status works only if checking feature has been enabled for the vendor

**Check-in Feature Overview**  
The "Check-in" feature allows vendors to acknowledge their scheduled opening time. **By default, this feature is disabled and does not require a check-in status to be sent.** To activate the check-in flow, please contact your account manager.

**How the Check-in Feature Works?**  
This feature enables you to confirm the upcoming opening of your shop up to 30 minutes before its scheduled opening hours. If the partner fails to acknowledge, the shop will remain closed even if it is scheduled to be open. However, the shop can still be opened by calling the API with a "OPEN" status.

post.description:
# Prerequisites

Set Up a Webhook to receive Order Events:
- *Step 1:* Develop a webhook to receive live order events.
- *Step 2:* Ensure the webhook is ready to receive updates for any modifications during the order lifecycle (e.g., status changes, cancellations) and share the endpoint with platform/update in partner portal etc.

# Webhook notification

You will receive a `POST` request webhook notifications regarding newly placed orders or order status changes. Depending on the integration type, next options are available:

- *Partner Picking Device:*
  - `RECEIVED` - The initial status of the order. This status means that the order processing has not yet started by the partner.
  - `READY_FOR_PICKUP` - Order picking and packing is finished by the partner and is ready for pickup by a delivery rider.
  - `DISPATCHED` - Order has been dispatched.
  - `CANCELED` - Order is canceled by the customer, delivery rider or the partner.

- *Pelican Picking Device:*
  - `READY_FOR_PICKUP` - Order picking and packing is finished by the partner and is ready for pickup by a delivery rider.
  - `CANCELED` - Order is canceled by the customer, delivery rider or the partner.

*Please note*: to enhance API call security, a static token for webhook notifications can be added through the Vendor Portal.

grant_type.description:
The `grant_type` specifies the type of OAuth 2.0 grant being used for obtaining the access token.
Currently only `client_credentials` is supported.

client_id.description:
The `client_id` is a unique identifier assigned to the client application. 
This value is used to authenticate the application requesting the access token.
Ensure that this is kept secure and not exposed publicly.

client_secret.description:
The `client_secret` is a confidential value known only to the client and the authorization server.
It is used in conjunction with the `client_id` to authenticate the client application. 
Ensure that this is kept secure and not exposed publicly.

vendors.description: Set of vendor IDs. If `vendors = ["*"]`, products will be assigned to all vendors associated with the chain

title.description:
Product title (one per locale)
- Keys are in the format of [ISO 639-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_639-1) language code and [ISO 3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country codes separated by `_` (e.g., 'en_SG')
- Values are the corresponding titles

barcodes.description: List of GTINs (barcodes) for the item. Is required if `is_sold_by_weight` is set as `false`.

description.description:
Product description (one per locale)
- Keys are in the format of [ISO 639-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_639-1) language code and [ISO 3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country codes separated by `_` (e.g., 'en_SG')
- Values are the corresponding descriptions

images.description:
List of image URLs. Image must meet the following requirements:

**Image Size Requirements**  
- Minimum resolution: 400x400 pixels

**Accepted Formats**  
- JPEG (.jpg)  
- PNG (.png)

**Image Criteria**  
- White background  
- Product centered in frame  
- Full item shown, including packaging

price.description: Total price of the product in local currency

is_sold_by_weight.description: set it as `true` if the product is sold by weight

access_token.description:
The `access_token` is a JSON Web Token (JWT) that is used to authenticate requests to the Partner API. 
This token must be included in the `Authorization` header as a Bearer token in each API request 
and valid for a limited time (as specified by the `expires_in` field).

token_type.description:
The `token_type` indicates the type of the token used for authentication. 
Currently only `Bearer` is supported, which means the `access_token` should be included in the `Authorization` header with the prefix `Bearer `.

expires_in.description: Token expiration time in seconds. After this period, the token will no longer be valid and a new token will need to be issued.

base_weight.description:
Since products sold by weight do not have a fixed weight, their price is based on a specific reference weight, known as the 'base weight'.
Eg. Pineapple - 1 EUR/1 kg - where base weight is 1kg.
Required if `is_sold_by_weight = true`

base_weight_unit.description:
Unit of the `base_weight` value. Optional; defaults to `KG` when omitted.
Independent of the other weight units and may differ from them.

average_weight_per_piece.description:
Avg weight of the piece - indicates the approximate weight of an item that is sold by weight.
Eg. Pineapple - Average weight - 3kg.
This can be shown to the users to give them an idea of how heavy the product is.
Optional; only present for weightable items that are ordered by piece.

average_weight_per_piece_unit.description:
Unit of the `average_weight_per_piece` value. Optional; defaults to `KG` when omitted.
Independent of the other weight units and may differ from them.

minimum_starting_weight.description:
The minimum orderable weight for the product - the smallest quantity a customer is allowed to order.
Distinct from `base_weight`, which is the pricing reference weight.
Optional; not present for all items.

minimum_starting_weight_unit.description:
Unit of the `minimum_starting_weight` value. Optional; defaults to `KG` when omitted.
Independent of the other weight units and may differ from them.

catalog.WeightUnit.description: Unit of measurement for a weight value.

duplicated_products.description:
This field is populated when the system detects an overlap of SKUs between the current API request and prior requests. Since product creation can sometimes require human intervention, it's crucial to prevent duplicate SKUs in multiple requests to minimize complexity and potential delays 

Each item in the list is a string in the format `vendor_id:SKU`. 
*These products were excluded from the request and will not be processed*

barcodes.description: List of GTINs (barcodes) for the product. Replaces the deprecated `barcode` field. Currently limited to 1 barcode.

catalog.ProductAdditionResult.description: Detailed information about the product addition job that is created through the POST /catalog endpoint. This includes item-level feedback and data available during or after job processing.

duplicated_products.description:
This field is populated when the system detects an overlap of SKUs between the current API request and prior requests. Since product creation can sometimes require human intervention, it's crucial to prevent duplicate SKUs in multiple requests to minimize complexity and potential delays 

Each item in the list is a string in the format `vendor_id:SKU`. 
*These products were excluded from the request and will not be processed*

item_level_feedback.description:
This field provides detailed feedback for individual products in the request. Each item contains information about the specific product, including identifiers and any relevant status or feedback details.
This feedback allows clients to understand and address issues with specific products without needing to retry the entire request. It is especially useful in bulk operations where partial success is expected.
Each item in the list follows the `catalog.ItemLevelFeedback` schema, which includes fields like `platform_vendor_id`, `sku`, `status` and `rejection_reasons`.

- EXPIRING_SOON - Expiring stock to sell quickly

discount_subtype.description:
Type of the discount applied for a given set of products. Required if `active` is true. Supported values:
- `PERCENTAGE`: if `discount_value` is set as `10`, then 10% off is shown. If the original price changes, the promo price will change as well
- `ABSOLUTE`: if `discount_value` is set as `10`, then $10 off is shown (currency depends on the country and the vendor setup). If the original price changes, the promo price will change as well
- `FINAL_PRICE`: if `discount_value` is set as `10`, the price will be shown as "final price $10". If the original price changes, the promo price will stay $10

discount_value.description:
Value of the discount. Required if `active` is true. Validation rules differ depending on the `discount_subtype`:
- `discount_subtype = PERCENTAGE`. `discount_value` is a positive double in the range of 1-100 and it can have up to 3 digits after the decimal point. For example: 12.435
- `discount_subtype = ABSOLUTE`. `discount_value` is a positive double (higher local currency) and it can have up to 3 digits after the decimal point. For example: 123.435
- `discount_subtype = FINAL_PRICE`. `discount_value` is a positive double (higher local currency) and it can have up to 3 digits after the decimal point. For example: 123.435

*Please note*, for weighted products `discount_value` for FINAL_PRICE and ABSOLUTE `discount_subtype` should be sent for the `base_weight`

status.description:
Depending on the integration type, next options are available:

- *Partner Picking Device:*
  - `RECEIVED` - The initial status of the order. This status means that the order processing has not yet started by the partner.
  - `READY_FOR_PICKUP` - Order picking and packing is finished by the partner and is ready for pickup by a delivery rider.
  - `DISPATCHED` - Order has been dispatched.
  - `CANCELED` - Order is canceled by the customer, delivery rider or the partner.

- *Pelican Picking Device:*
  - `READY_FOR_PICKUP` - Order picking and packing is finished by the partner and is ready for pickup by a delivery rider.
  - `CANCELED` - Order is canceled by the customer, delivery rider or the partner.

 - `LOGISTICS_DELIVERY` - Yemeksepeti rider is responsible for delivering the order to the customer

promotion_status.description:
Indicates the presence and status of promotion data in the item.promotion field.

In certain exceptional cases, the `item.promotion` data may be unavailable, resulting in an empty field. The `promotion_status` field is crucial because it allows you to distinguish between an empty `item.promotion` because:
- No promotion was applied (`AVAILABLE`)
- Promotion data was unavailable (`UNAVAILABLE`)

☝️**Please note**: 
- **Accurate Order Totals:** Even if the item-level promotion details are missing (i.e., `promotion_status` is `UNAVAILABLE` and `item.promotion` is empty), the order totals (`order_total` and `sub_total` within the `payment` field) will still be accurate. These totals include any applicable discounts.
- **Dynamic Status:** The `promotion_status` may change from `UNAVAILABLE` to `AVAILABLE` during the order lifecycle. The Partner API backend will attempt to retrieve the detailed promotion data again with every subsequent order status change.

status.description:
This field defines order status. Some rules must be followed providing correct status:
- If the order cannot be fulfilled, it can be cancelled
- If the status is being updated as `CANCELLED`, an appropriate cancellation reason needs to be also entered
- For `VENDOR_DELIVERY` transport_type
  - Accepted values are `CANCELLED` or `DISPATCHED`
  - Once the order is picked and dispatched for delivery, update the status as `DISPATCHED`
  - Orders cannot be `CANCELLED` after the status is set to `DISPATCHED` and vice versa
- For `LOGISTICS_DELIVERY` transport_type
  - Accepted values are `CANCELLED` or `READY_FOR_PICKUP`
  - Once the order is picked and ready for pickup, update the status as `READY_FOR_PICKUP`
  - Orders cannot be `CANCELLED` after the status is set to “READY_FOR_PICKUP” and vice versa
- `UPDATE_CART` status is used for item modifications. In contrast to other statuses, the Partner can call API with UPDATE_CART as many times as needed to ensure the order contains the correct set of items
